objective: Define the smallest first real Verilator-facing --use-gpu path after GitHub issue #27 closure, without implementing execution or broad Verilator replacement behavior in this gate.

definition_decision.reason: The post-source-closure bridge retry closed #27 with scoped pulp_ita_mha 64x1 coverage-output equivalence. The next useful boundary is a first Verilator-facing --use-gpu path that reuses exactly one reviewed source closure and sidecar path, while keeping arbitrary filelists, hidden dependency inference, automatic allocation, timing, and production throughput out of scope.
definition_decision.weakest_point: The repo does not currently keep a standalone .filelist source-of-truth file for the selected MHA path; the source list lives in a reviewed launch template. A future implementation must either materialize a reproducible filelist from that template or accept an explicitly reviewed equivalent source list, without pretending that arbitrary -f dependency inference exists.

accepted_schedule_sources: an equivalent reviewed explicit schedule field carried by the operator-facing invocation
rejected_schedule_sources: --use-gpu without explicit state and step counts
debug JSON without reviewed sidecar metadata

must_accept_only_if: the selected known target and top match the reviewed definition
source closure is reviewed and complete
sidecar metadata is explicit and reviewed
unsupported paths fail closed without CPU-as-GPU fallback

fail_closed_cases: top module not matching selected known path
missing explicit state and step counts when --use-gpu is present
attempt to use CPU execution as GPU evidence
attempt to infer dependencies from arbitrary -f input
required_tests_and_docs_for_implementati: missing or mismatched top rejection test
--use-gpu shorthand expansion or explicit diagnostic test
public docs that describe scoped support rather than general Verilator replacement

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_use_gpu_first_real_path_gate
must_review: whether the selected known target and template are narrow enough for FC-042
whether --use-gpu semantics avoid hidden schedule inference and automatic allocation claims
whether the absence of a standalone tracked .filelist source is handled as an implementation requirement instead of a current support claim
whether fail-closed cases cover the operator-visible risks before implementation
